title: Bit package manifest (bit.json)
description: A Bit project's manifest. May contain '//' and '/* */' comments and trailing commas (JSONC) — bit add preserves them byte-for-byte via the CST edit layer (#1479), and the extension associates this filename with the jsonc language for that reason. See spec/SPEC.md §17.7.

name.description: The project's name. Used as the default output name for a directory build (`bit build <dir>`, written inside that directory, e.g. `myproject/myproject`) when no `-o` is given. Optional — a manifest that only declares dependencies needs no name.

dependencies.description: Third-party module dependencies. Each key is the name the dependency is imported under; each value is a single string naming where to fetch it and which version/branch/commit to resolve.

additionalProperties.description: One of: a direct git-host spec `gitHost/owner/repo@ref` (gitHost is one of github.com, gitlab.com, codeberg.org, bitbucket.org, git.sr.ht); a vanity name resolved via an HTTPS `bit-import:` document, e.g. `bitlang.org/pkg/http@^2.0.1`; an explicit `ssh://[user@]host/owner/repo[/...]@ref`; or a local filesystem dependency (`./rel`, `../rel`, `/abs`, or a `file://` URL) with no `@ref` at all. `ref` is a version constraint (`1.2.3` exact, `^1.2.3` caret, or `~1.2.3` tilde — no `v` prefix), a branch name, or a 40-character commit SHA.
